datasets.name: income_inequality
queryLines:
WITH raw_data AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    read_files(
      '/Workspace/Users/szczerski@gmail.com/mean-median-eurostat/eurostat_mean-median_2026.csv',
      format => 'csv',
      header => true,
      inferSchema => true
    )
  WHERE
    TIME_PERIOD = 2022
    AND nace_r2 = 'B-S_X_O'
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    geo AS Kod_Kraju,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN indic_se = 'MEAN_E_EUR' THEN OBS_VALUE
      END
    ) AS Srednia,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN indic_se = 'MED_E_EUR' THEN OBS_VALUE
      END
    ) AS Mediana
  FROM
    raw_data
  GROUP BY
    geo
),
with_country_names AS (
  SELECT
    Kod_Kraju,
    Srednia,
    Mediana,
    CASE Kod_Kraju
      WHEN 'AT' THEN 'Austria'
      WHEN 'BE' THEN 'Belgium'
      WHEN 'BG' THEN 'Bulgaria'
      WHEN 'HR' THEN 'Croatia'
      WHEN 'CY' THEN 'Cyprus'
      WHEN 'CZ' THEN 'Czechia'
      WHEN 'DK' THEN 'Denmark'
      WHEN 'EE' THEN 'Estonia'
      WHEN 'FI' THEN 'Finland'
      WHEN 'FR' THEN 'France'
      WHEN 'DE' THEN 'Germany'
      WHEN 'EL' THEN 'Greece'
      WHEN 'HU' THEN 'Hungary'
      WHEN 'IE' THEN 'Ireland'
      WHEN 'IT' THEN 'Italy'
      WHEN 'LV' THEN 'Latvia'
      WHEN 'LT' THEN 'Lithuania'
      WHEN 'LU' THEN 'Luxembourg'
      WHEN 'MT' THEN 'Malta'
      WHEN 'NL' THEN 'Netherlands'
      WHEN 'PL' THEN 'Poland'
      WHEN 'PT' THEN 'Portugal'
      WHEN 'RO' THEN 'Romania'
      WHEN 'SK' THEN 'Slovakia'
      WHEN 'SI' THEN 'Slovenia'
      WHEN 'ES' THEN 'Spain'
      WHEN 'SE' THEN 'Sweden'
      WHEN 'CH' THEN 'Switzerland'
      WHEN 'AL' THEN 'Albania'
      WHEN 'BA' THEN 'Bosnia and Herzegovina'
      WHEN 'IS' THEN 'Iceland'
      WHEN 'MK' THEN 'North Macedonia'
      WHEN 'NO' THEN 'Norway'
      WHEN 'RS' THEN 'Serbia'
    END AS Country_EN,
    ROUND(((Srednia - Mediana) / Srednia) * 100, 2) AS Rozwarstwienie_Pct
  FROM
    pivoted
)
SELECT
  Kod_Kraju,
  Country_EN,
  Srednia,
  Mediana,
  Rozwarstwienie_Pct
FROM
  with_country_names
WHERE
  Srednia IS NOT NULL
  AND Mediana IS NOT NULL
  AND Kod_Kraju NOT IN ('EA19', 'EA20', 'EU27_2020')
ORDER BY
  Rozwarstwienie_Pct DESC

datasets.name: b082f979
queryLines:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    dbacademy.default.notebook
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(Rozwarstwienie_Pct) AS min_inequality,
    MAX(Rozwarstwienie_Pct) AS max_inequality,
    MIN(Happiness_Score) AS min_happiness,
    MAX(Happiness_Score) AS max_happiness
  FROM
    base_data
)
SELECT
  b.Kod_Kraju,
  b.Rozwarstwienie_Pct,
  b.Happiness_Score,
  -- Min-Max normalization (0-1) for Rozwarstwienie_Pct
  ROUND(
    (b.Rozwarstwienie_Pct - s.min_inequality) / (s.max_inequality - s.min_inequality),
    4
  ) AS Rozwarstwienie_Normalized,
  -- Min-Max normalization (0-1) for Happiness_Score
  ROUND(
    (b.Happiness_Score - s.min_happiness) / (s.max_happiness - s.min_happiness),
    4
  ) AS Happiness_Normalized,
  -- Min-Max normalization (0-100) for easier interpretation
  ROUND(
    ((b.Rozwarstwienie_Pct - s.min_inequality) / (s.max_inequality - s.min_inequality)) * 100,
    2
  ) AS Rozwarstwienie_Normalized_Pct,
  ROUND(
    ((b.Happiness_Score - s.min_happiness) / (s.max_happiness - s.min_happiness)) * 100,
    2
  ) AS Happiness_Normalized_Pct
FROM
  base_data b CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY
  b.Rozwarstwienie_Pct DESC
